  • Rotating Head: Precision Bearing Drive (No Sleeve Friction)
  • Rotation Speed: >1500 rpm (30%+ Higher Than Hose Type)
  • Trigger: Two-Stage
  • Bearing Type Advantages: High Rotation Speed, Stable Operation, No Stuttering, Long Service Life, Usable at Low Pressure

3. Product Features

  • Dual Air Flow Control: Dual control design, trigger for on/off, plus air flow regulator for precise and continuous wind speed adjustment, meeting different cleaning needs.
  • Premium Durable Material: Made of aluminum alloy + engineering plastic with protective baking varnish, rust-proof, corrosion-resistant and wear-resistant, compact and solid structure for long service life; air inlet connector is 304 stainless steel, anti-oxidation and not easy to damage.
  • 2 Interchangeable Nozzles: Equipped with 2 types of nozzles (direct spray + brush head), replaceable at any time according to different cleaning scenarios.
  • Ergonomic Design: Handle fits hand grip perfectly, long trigger for easy operation, handle block protects fingers from injury during use.
  • Efficient Cleaning Principle: Combined with air pressure spiral wave and high-frequency vibration principle, matched with precision bearing-driven rotating head, rotation speed up to 1500rpm+, efficient cleaning, time-saving, labor-saving, energy-saving and environmentally friendly.
  • Dual Tube Separation Design: Independent air and liquid, stable pressure supply, avoiding air-liquid mixing affecting cleaning effect, suitable for various cleaning scenarios.

4. Package Includes

  • 1× Cleaning Gun Main Unit
  • 1× Direct Spray Nozzle
  • 1× Brush Nozzle
  • 2× 1/4 Inch Quick Connectors

5. Application

  • Car Interior Cleaning: Clean air vents, dashboard, leather seats, carpets, car roof, doors, trunk, wheels, grilles and other gaps and dead corners.
  • Special Car Cleaning: Deep dust removal for engine compartment and car gaps, adapted to high-speed rotation of bearing type for more thorough cleaning.
  • Household Cleaning: Dust removal for furniture gaps, air conditioner filters, keyboards, curtains, sofas, etc.
  • Industrial Cleaning: Dust removal for equipment gaps, workshop corners, etc.

6. Notes

  • Recommended working pressure: 4–8 bar (optimal 5–7 bar), minimum starting pressure ≥2 bar (bearing type can run normally at low pressure).

How to Change Ignition Coils and Spark Plugs?

1.Disconnect the old ignition coil and spark plugs
2.Disconnect your battery’s negative terminal
3.Locate the ignition coil and spark plugs to be replaced.
4.Release the clip on the plug running into the side of coil.
5.Use a wrench to unscrew the bolts holding the original coil in place
6.Extract original ignition coil and spark plugs from the engine bay
7.Swapping in the new ignition coil and spark plugs
8.Prior to installation, compare the new coil to the old one
9.Orient the new coil in the same direction
10.Insert the bolts to hold the coil in place
11.Activate the New ignition coil and spark plugs
12.Connect the plug into the side coil
13.Plug in ignition cables according to the order written on them.
14.Reconnect the battery
15.Start the vehicle to test the new ignition coil and spark plugs


Note

In preparation for the replacement, the vehicle should be turned off and cooled for a certain period of time before starting the replacement.

pay attention to the cleanliness of the entire operation, must wipe the ignition coil around the dust and oil, if into the combustion chamber, will have serious adverse effects, try to wear gloves to operate.
